notes.title: Language Patch: Chinese
notes.content: In this patch I added Simplified Chinese as an available language, improved some visual details, and fixed a few very minor bugs. Thank you.

notes.title: Mini visual update
notes.content:
- Several details were added to the intro of scene 6.
- A "damage received" effect was added during the fight in scene 6.
- A visual bug in Moreno’s eyes was fixed, which caused them to shift erratically during animations, especially the blocking one.

notes.title: Mini voice update
notes.content: I updated the narrator's voice in chapter 10 to a (I think better) version.
